- SDR: every tool that can transmit (Listen, APRS, SSTV, Meshtastic) now has two tabs at the top, Reception and Transmission, each on its own page, so the two are never mixed. Reception is what you had; Transmission holds the status, the frequency, what to send and the power settings
- SDR: the gain is now a slider with the automatic mode shown on the bar, in every tool
- SDR: every radio with several groups of tools gets category cards
- SDR: a HackRF amplifier that has died is detected (the level drops with it on) and is left off for the session, with a note and a "Try again" button
- Transmit: the licence is asked only when you press send, with a checkbox and your call sign; the Meshtastic node no longer reports 868 MHz as out of band
- Radiosondes: the settings are shown at once instead of in a collapsed card
- Credits: OnAir is now credited in the licenses and the About page, as its author asks
